Escolhe o tipo de ficheiro que será expo:
Chooses the type of file to export.
The format determines the available codecs and features.
MP4 é indicado para partilhar vídeos e r:
MP4 is suitable for sharing videos and playing them on most devices.
Use H.264 for wider compatibility or H.265 for more efficient compression.
QuickTime (MOV) permite exportar ProRes:
QuickTime (MOV) allows ProRes export for video editing.
ProRes files are larger but avoid excessive compression between editing stages.
Matroska reúne vídeo, áudio e metadados:
Matroska combines video, audio and metadata in a flexible container.
It is useful for archiving and playback in compatible players.
AVI disponibiliza Motion JPEG e H.264 pa:
AVI offers Motion JPEG and H.264 for compatible applications.
Motion JPEG stores each frame separately and uses more space.
PNG guarda a imagem sem perda e preserva:
PNG saves images without loss and preserves transparency.
For video, each frame is saved as a numbered file.
JPEG reduz o tamanho com compressão com:
JPEG reduces size with lossy compression and does not store transparency.
For video, it exports a sequence of numbered frames.
WebP permite imagens compactas com trans:
WebP supports compact images with transparency.
Check that your destination application supports this format.
BMP é um formato de imagem simples, com:
BMP is a simple image format with large files.
Prefer PNG when you need transparency and lossless compression.
GIF cria uma animação em repetição, limi:
GIF creates a looping animation limited to 256 colors per palette.
Gradients may show dithering; MP4 video preserves colors better.
MP3 exporta apenas o áudio com compressã:
MP3 exports only audio, using lossy compression.
It is suitable for sharing and playback on many devices.
WAV exporta apenas o áudio PCM sem compr:
WAV exports only uncompressed PCM audio.
It is suitable for editing, with larger files than MP3.
Define como a imagem ou o vídeo será com:
Determines how the image or video is compressed.
This affects quality, file size and compatibility.
H.264 / AVC é uma escolha segura para pa:
H.264 / AVC is a reliable choice for sharing and general playback.
It has broad compatibility and usually encodes faster than H.265.
H.265 / HEVC pode guardar qualidade seme:
H.265 / HEVC can store similar quality in less space.
Encoding is slower and some older devices cannot play it.
Apple ProRes é indicado para edição e fi:
Apple ProRes is intended for editing and intermediate files.
Choose a profile below; quality and size increase from Proxy to XQ.
JPEG comprime cada imagem individualment:
JPEG compresses each image individually, losing some detail.
In AVI, Motion JPEG simplifies editing but creates large files.
PNG preserva os píxeis sem compressão co:
PNG preserves pixels without lossy compression.
It also retains transparency in exported images.
GIF cria uma animação com uma paleta lim:
GIF creates an animation with a limited color palette.
It is not suitable for preserving all the gradients in a video.
WebP comprime imagens e suporta transpar:
WebP compresses images and supports transparency.
Use it when the destination accepts WebP and you need a compact file.
BMP guarda uma imagem num formato simple:
BMP stores an image in a simple, uncompact format.
Use PNG for smaller files without losing visual information.
Escolhe a qualidade e a amostragem de co:
Chooses ProRes quality and color sampling.
A higher profile does not recover details missing from the source.
422 Proxy: ficheiros leves para montagem:
422 Proxy: smaller files for assembly and offline editing.
It uses more compression; prefer 422 or HQ for final delivery.
422 LT: reduz o tamanho mantendo boa qua:
422 LT: reduces size while retaining good editing quality.
It is a compromise between Proxy and standard ProRes 422.
422: opção equilibrada para edição e exp:
422: a balanced option for editing and intermediate exports.
Preserves more information than LT while using less space than HQ.
422 HQ: comprime menos para preservar ce:
422 HQ: uses less compression to preserve detailed scenes.
Suitable for editing masters, with larger files than 422.
4444: preserva a resolução de cor comple:
4444: preserves full color resolution for compositing and color grading.
This video pipeline exports color without a transparency channel.
4444 XQ: usa menos compressão para traba:
4444 XQ: uses less compression for demanding compositing work.
Uses more space and exports without transparency in this pipeline.
Escolhe se a prioridade é a qualidade vi:
Chooses whether visual quality or bitrate takes priority.
CRF is practical for files; VBR and CBR give more control over the data rate.
CRF ajusta a taxa de bits conforme a com:
CRF adjusts bitrate to the complexity of each scene.
Maintains roughly constant quality, but the final size varies.
VBR tenta atingir a taxa média definida:
VBR tries to reach the chosen average bitrate in one pass.
Complex scenes receive more data; final size is approximate.
CBR limita o fluxo em torno da taxa esco:
CBR constrains the stream around the selected bitrate.
Useful when a stable rate is required, with less flexibility for complex scenes.
Um CRF menor preserva mais detalhes e au:
A lower CRF preserves more detail and increases file size.
Try 18-23 for H.264; compare a short section before exporting everything.
Define quantos megabits por segundo serã:
Sets how many megabits per second are allocated to video.
Higher values help complex scenes but increase file size.
%1 dá prioridade a terminar a codificaçã:
%1 prioritizes finishing the encode faster.
At the same quality, files tend to be larger than with slower presets.
%1 equilibra o tempo de codificação e a:
%1 balances encoding time and compression.
It is a useful starting point for everyday exports.
%1 dedica mais tempo a procurar uma comp:
%1 spends more time finding efficient compression.
Can reduce file size, with diminishing returns in the slowest modes.
A velocidade altera o esforço de compres:
Speed changes compression effort, not video playback speed.
Slower presets take longer to make better use of the same quality target.
Define a amostragem das cores e a precis:
Sets color sampling and pixel precision.
More detailed formats may require compatible players and editors.
Automatic uses yuv420p for this export.
It is the most compatible option for H.264 and H.265.
4:2:0 de 8 bits reduz a resolução de cor:
8-bit 4:2:0 reduces color resolution to save space.
Suitable for general playback and most devices.
4:4:4 de 8 bits mantém a resolução de co:
8-bit 4:4:4 retains full color resolution.
Helps text and colored edges but has lower compatibility.
4:2:2 de 10 bits é usado pelos perfis Pr:
10-bit 4:2:2 is used by ProRes 422 profiles.
The extra precision does not recover colors lost in the source.
4:4:4 de 10 bits alimenta os perfis ProR:
10-bit 4:4:4 feeds the ProRes 4444 profiles.
Retains full color resolution without creating extra source detail.
4:2:0 com gama completa é usado pelo Mot:
Full-range 4:2:0 is used by Motion JPEG.
The program selects this automatically for AVI with MJPEG.
O perfil H.264 define os recursos de com:
The H.264 profile defines the permitted compression features.
Keep Automatic unless the destination device requires a particular profile.
O encoder escolhe um perfil compatível c:
The encoder chooses a profile compatible with the pixel format.
Recommended when the destination player has no specific requirement.
Baseline usa recursos simples para leito:
Baseline uses simple features for older H.264 players.
Compresses less efficiently and should only be used when needed.
Main equilibra compatibilidade e recurso:
Main balances compatibility and compression features.
Useful for equipment that does not accept the High profile.
High oferece compressão eficiente para v:
High provides efficient compression for 4:2:0 video.
Suitable for most current H.264 players.
High 4:4:4 permite manter a resolução co:
High 4:4:4 allows full color resolution to be retained.
Requires a compatible player, especially with yuv444p pixels.
O encoder escolhe o nível conforme a res:
The encoder chooses the level from the resolution and frame rate.
Use this to avoid imposing unsuitable limits on the video.
O nível %1 limita a resolução, os fotogr:
Level %1 limits the permitted resolution, frame rate and bitrate.
Select it only if the destination device requires that limit.
O nível indica os limites de reprodução:
The level describes the playback limits a device must support.
Higher levels do not improve quality; Automatic avoids unnecessary restrictions.
Inclui as faixas de áudio existentes no:
Includes audio tracks present in the source file.
Disable for silent video; it does not create audio where none exists.
Escolhe como o áudio será guardado no fi:
Chooses how audio is stored in the final file.
Copy avoids recompression when the format and trimming allow it.
Mantém os pacotes de áudio originais qua:
Retains the original audio packets when they are compatible.
The program re-encodes audio when the format or trim requires it.
AAC é uma opção compacta e compatível co:
AAC is compact and compatible with MP4 and QuickTime.
Use 192 kbps as a starting point for stereo audio.
PCM de 16 bits guarda o áudio sem compre:
16-bit PCM stores audio without compression.
Useful for editing but takes more space than AAC or MP3.
MP3 oferece ampla compatibilidade com co:
MP3 offers broad compatibility with lossy compression.
Higher rates better preserve music and complex sounds.
%1 reserva esta quantidade de dados por:
%1 reserves this amount of data per second for audio.
Lower rates save space; higher rates better preserve music and detail.
Define a quantidade de dados usada para:
Sets the amount of data used to compress audio.
A higher rate can reduce artifacts but cannot recover quality already lost.
Define quantas amostras de áudio são gua:
Sets how many audio samples are stored per second.
Keep the original rate unless the destination requires another.
Original mantém a frequência de amostrag:
Original retains the source sampling rate.
Avoids unnecessary audio conversion.
44.100 Hz é uma frequência comum em músi:
44,100 Hz is common for music and CD audio.
Use it if the destination requires this standard.
48.000 Hz é comum em produção e edição d:
48,000 Hz is common in video production and editing.
Converting to this rate does not create new audio detail.
Escolhe a disposição dos canais de áudio:
Chooses the arrangement of exported audio channels.
Converting to fewer channels mixes down the source channels.
Original mantém a quantidade de canais d:
Original retains the source channel count when the codec allows it.
Suitable when you do not need to convert multichannel audio.
Mono mistura o áudio num único canal.\nÉ:
Mono mixes audio into a single channel.
Useful for speech or files that require only one channel.
Estéreo exporta dois canais, esquerdo e:
Stereo exports two channels, left and right.

Use este motor para aumentar a resolução: Use this engine to enlarge photos, live-action footage or animation. The model matters: Plus focuses on real-world textures, while Anime and AnimeVideo focus on drawn lines.
Foi desenvolvido para anime e ilustraçõe: Developed for anime and illustrations, with attention to outlines and flat colours. Try noise reduction on compressed material; leave it off for clean drawings to avoid erasing fine lines.
É uma alternativa rápida para ampliar an: A fast option for enlarging animation and restoring soft outlines. Choose A for stronger blur, B for mild blur and C for already sharp lines. Photography is not its main use.
É o ponto de partida para episódios de a: A starting point for anime episodes and 2D animation. It costs less per frame than Anime x4, which helps with long videos. Check eyes, hair and subtitles in Preview to judge whether lines are preserved.
Indicado para ilustrações, capas e desen: Intended for illustrations, covers and anime drawings. It restores outlines and small details but may reinterpret thin lines. For video, compare it with AnimeVideo v3: this option usually requires more processing.
Use em fotografias e filmagens com textu: Use for photos and footage with textures such as skin, fabric and plants. The model estimates details missing from the low-resolution source, so grain and noise may look different. You do not need to apply it again under Image enhancement.
Modelo da família Real-CUGAN voltado par: A Real-CUGAN model for anime and drawings. Its treatment of lines and flat colours differs from SE; Pro does not mean it will look better in every scene. Compare a moving section before processing the entire video.
Use para ampliar anime que apresenta ruí: Use for anime with noise or compression marks. SE offers more noise-reduction levels: start with little or none and increase only if the marks remain visible. Strong cleaning can also soften details.
Permite limpar problemas da imagem antes: Clean up image defects before export using filters or a restoration model. You do not have to enable this alongside Upscaling: an already clean image may lose detail if treated too heavily.
Reduz os pontos e manchas que variam pel: Reduces speckles and blotches, especially in dark areas. Start with a low strength and check skin, hair and fine textures. Lower the value if they look smooth or blurred.
Aumenta o contraste junto às bordas para: Increases contrast near edges to make the image look sharper. It cannot recover detail lost in the source. High values can create bright outlines around objects and make noise more visible.
Atenua os quadrados visíveis em vídeos m: Reduces visible blocks in heavily compressed video, especially shadows and flat backgrounds. Use it only when this defect is present; on clean material it may soften detail without providing a benefit.
Suaviza os degraus entre tons parecidos,: Smooths steps between similar shades, such as colour bands in skies and shadows. Use enough strength to hide bands without removing subtle variations. Final compression can introduce banding again.
Acrescenta uma textura fina à imagem. Po: Adds a fine texture. It can hide overly smooth gradients or create a film-like look, but makes compression harder and may increase file size. Leave it at zero for a clean result.
O codec transforma os fotogramas num fic: The codec turns frames into a video file. H.264 is a practical choice for playback and sharing; H.265 may use less space but requires player support. Choose ProRes if you plan to continue editing.
Escolha CRF quando quiser definir a qual: Choose CRF to set quality and let file size vary with the scenes. VBR targets an average data rate. CBR is useful when the destination needs a more constant rate, but can waste space on simple scenes.
Este número controla a perda de detalhe: This number controls detail loss during compression: lower values preserve more and produce larger files. For H.264, 18 is a useful starting point. Lowering CRF cannot recover details already missing from the source or interpolated frames.
Controla o trabalho dedicado a comprimir: Controls the effort spent compressing the result after frame processing. A slower preset can produce a smaller file at the same quality. It does not change frame rate or playback speed.
Determina como a cor é guardada em cada: Determines how colour is stored in each frame. yuv420p works in most players but reduces colour resolution. yuv444p preserves coloured edges and text better, with larger files and more limited compatibility.
O perfil indica quais recursos de H.264: The profile identifies which H.264 features the player must support. Leave it on Automatic to match the selected pixel format. Only force Baseline, Main or High if the destination device requires it.
O nível reúne limites de resolução, foto: The level sets limits on resolution, frame rate and data rate. Automatic lets the encoder choose a suitable level. Raising it manually does not improve the image; a level that is too low may prevent export.
Quanto tempo leva no seu computador?: How long does it take on your computer?
O teste exporta uma amostra de 0,25 s, e: The test exports a 0.25-second, 1080p, 24 fps sample with upscaling and RIFE v4.6. Timing includes preparation, GPU processing and encoding. The one-minute forecast is approximate: content, temperature and other programs affect results. 8K tests need more memory and may take longer.
